description: Agent-based simulation of vaccination behavior adoption driven by social influence and information diffusion on a social network, with policy interventions and campaign effects.

modules.name: NetworkGenerator
modules.description: Constructs the social network with small-world or scale-free structure, assigns households, and initializes tie strengths.

notes: Homophily and assortativity enforced by iterative edge swaps that increase assortativity metrics without isolating nodes

modules.name: PolicyCampaign
modules.description: Schedules and emits policy signals (campaign intensity, trust boost, incentives, mandate, and misinfo takedown) that affect information and adoption dynamics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if params.campaign_start_day <= t <= params.campaign_end_day:
  trust_boost <- params.campaign_trust_boost * params.campaign_intensity
  incentive <- params.incentive_amount * params.campaign_intensity
else:
  trust_boost <- 0.0
  incentive <- 0.0
mandate_active <- (t >= params.mandate_start_day)
misinfo_takedown <- params.misinformation_takedown_rate * (1.0 if t >= params.campaign_start_day else 0.0)
emit signals: policy.trust_boost_t=trust_boost, policy.incentive_amount_t=incentive, policy.mandate_active_t=mandate_active, policy.misinfo_takedown_rate_t=misinfo_takedown
notes: Signals are consumed downstream by InformationPropagation and BehaviorAdoption

modules.name: InformationPropagation
modules.description: Propagates true information and misinformation over the social network using a weighted independent cascade with decay and fatigue.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  # Decay existing info levels
  i.info_true_level <- i.info_true_level * (1 - params.info_decay_rate)
  i.info_misinfo_level <- i.info_misinfo_level * (1 - params.info_decay_rate)
  # Self-initiated exposures (media/search)
  with prob params.self_initiated_exposure_rate: i.info_true_level += 1
  with prob params.self_initiated_exposure_rate: i.info_misinfo_level += 1
for each edge (i,j) in graph.social:
  w <- tie_strength(i,j)
  # True info sharing from i to j
  p_share_true <- params.base_share_prob_true * (1 + params.tie_strength_influence*(w-1)) * (1 + params.trust_sensitivity*(i.trust_in_institutions + policy.trust_boost_t - 0.5))
  p_share_true <- clip(p_share_true, 0, 1)
  if Bernoulli(p_share_true) and i.info_true_level > 0: j.info_true_level += 1
  # Misinfo sharing from i to j with takedown
  p_share_m <- params.base_share_prob_misinfo * (1 - policy.misinfo_takedown_rate_t) * (1 + params.tie_strength_influence*(w-1)) * (1 + params.trust_sensitivity*(0.5 - i.trust_in_institutions))
  p_share_m <- clip(p_share_m, 0, 1)
  if Bernoulli(p_share_m) and i.info_misinfo_level > 0: j.info_misinfo_level += 1
# Fatigue reduces subsequent sharing likelihood via state
for each person i:
  exposures_true_today <- count of true info increments
  exposures_m_today <- count of misinfo increments
  i.fatigue <- clip(i.fatigue + params.fatigue_increment_per_exposure*(exposures_true_today + exposures_m_today), 0, 1)
aggregate info.true_exposures_t and info.misinfo_exposures_t as totals for day t
notes: Sharing probabilities are modulated by tie strength and trust
Fatigue accumulates and can optionally be used to downweight future sharing (implemented by adjusting base_share_prob_* externally if desired)

modules.name: BehaviorAdoption
modules.description: Determines daily adoption decisions using a logistic function of social norms, perceived risk, trust, and incentives; mandates affect compliance.

update_rule.pseudocode:
new_adopters <- 0
for each person i where i.adoption_state == 0 and i.stubborn == 0:
  # Social norm: sample up to max_daily_contacts_to_consider neighbors
  N_i <- neighbors(i)
  S <- random_sample(N_i, size=min(len(N_i), params.max_daily_contacts_to_consider))
  norm_i <- mean([neighbor.adoption_state for neighbor in S]) if len(S)>0 else 0
  # Perceived risk blends personal risk and true info minus misinfo influence
  belief_adjust <- i.info_true_level - (1 - params.rebuttal_effectiveness) * i.info_misinfo_level * i.susceptibility_to_misinfo
  risk_i <- clip(i.risk_perception + 0.1 * belief_adjust, 0, 1)
  trust_eff <- clip(i.trust_in_institutions + policy.trust_boost_t, 0, 1)
  logit <- params.base_adoption_logit + params.weight_social_norm*norm_i + params.weight_risk*risk_i + params.weight_trust*trust_eff + params.weight_cost_incentive*policy.incentive_amount_t + Normal(0, params.private_signal_noise)
  p_adopt <- 1 / (1 + exp(-logit))
  # Mandate effect: increase effective probability or force compliance with enforcement
  if policy.mandate_active_t:
    p_enforce <- PolicyCampaign.mandate_enforcement_prob
    if Bernoulli(p_enforce):
      p_adopt <- max(p_adopt, 0.95)  # near-certain compliance when enforced
    else:
      # Soft effect of penalty on adoption propensity
      p_adopt <- clip(p_adopt + 0.002 * PolicyCampaign.noncompliance_penalty, 0, 1)
  if Bernoulli(p_adopt):
    i.adoption_state <- 1
    new_adopters += 1
# Vaccination is absorbing; habit_drop_prob can model decay if >0
if params.habit_drop_prob > 0:
  for each person j with j.adoption_state == 1:
    if Bernoulli(params.habit_drop_prob): j.adoption_state <- 0
cumulative_adopters <- count of persons with adoption_state == 1
emit adoption.new_adopters_t = new_adopters, adoption.cumulative_adopters_t = cumulative_adopters
notes: Mandate compliance is modeled via enforcement probability and penalty strength

modules.name: AggregationAndMetrics
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and applies optional smoothing and reporting adjustments.

update_rule.pseudocode:
report_new <- adoption.new_adopters_t
report_cum <- adoption.cumulative_adopters_t
# Adjust for reporting delay by buffering (if delay > 0)
if params.reporting_delay_days > 0:
  buffer.push(report_new), output prior item after delay
# Underreporting factor (<=1) scales observed counts
obs_new <- round(report_new * params.underreporting_factor)
obs_cum_share <- (report_cum * params.underreporting_factor) / params.n_agents
obs_misinfo <- info.misinfo_exposures_t / params.n_agents
obs_true <- info.true_exposures_t / params.n_agents
# Optional smoothing on new adoptions
obs_new_smoothed <- moving_average(obs_new, window=params.smoothing_window_days)
emit observable.new_adoptions_daily=obs_new_smoothed, observable.cumulative_adoption_share=obs_cum_share, observable.misinfo_exposure_index=obs_misinfo, observable.true_info_exposure_index=obs_true
notes: Cumulative share is normalized by population size

observables.formula_or_field: moving_average(sum(1 for adoption events at t), window=smoothing_window_days)

algorithms.IndependentCascadeWeighted: Edge-based diffusion where an informed node attempts to activate neighbors with probability p_ij = base_prob * f(tie_strength, trust, policy) and subject to per-step decay.
algorithms.LogisticAdoption: Daily adoption probability p = sigmoid(beta0 + b1*social_norm + b2*risk + b3*trust + b4*incentive + epsilon), with mandate modifiers.
algorithms.AssortativeRewiring: Iterative double-edge swaps to increase homophily/assortativity without changing node degrees.
algorithms.MovingAverage: Centered or trailing moving average smoothing for daily series with specified window.
